issues.title: 2024 yield baseline differs (+6% vs +4%)
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 8.2 gives 2024 as 17.69 t/ha (2025 is 6% higher). Agro Table 10 shows 2024 as 18.07 t/ha and +4%. Agro Appendix 2 (11,871.80 t) and Appendix 3 (11,869.80 t, 17.69 t/ha) over 671 ha support 17.69.

issues.title: P93E yield on mixed area basis
issues.detail: Agro Table 10 lists P93E as 94 ha with 7.30 t/ha (2025), but 248.26 t over 94 ha is 2.64 t/ha (Agro Appendix 2); 7.30 only works on 34 ha. The 2024 figure 13.85 is on 94 ha (1,301.58 t).

issues.title: Best block named wrongly in Agro text
issues.detail: Agro 7.1 says P13A1 had the highest yield at 21.15 t/ha. Table 10 shows P13A1 22.82 and P05H 21.15.

issues.title: 2025 monthly crop does not sum to total
issues.detail: Agro Appendix 3 gives Aug and Sep 2025 both as 1,043.68 t; the twelve months add to 11,468.82 t against the stated 11,489.06 t (20.24 t gap).

issues.title: Spraying labour: table says full, text says short 4
issues.detail: PA 3 table shows spraying workers 4 actual vs 4 required (total 43 vs 45), but PA 3.2 and the comment column say spraying workers were short by 4, with 4 to be recruited in June.

issues.title: Harvester adequacy differs
issues.detail: PA 3.1 says harvesters were adequate (31 vs 31, Dec 2025) yet PA says the 2025 crop budget was missed due to harvester shortage. Agro 4.1.4 says 4 harvesters short as of March 2026 and none assigned to P93E2.

issues.title: Harvesting interval: 16 days vs over 20 days
issues.detail: PA 7.3 (visit 14 May 2026) says the interval averaged 16 days. Agro Table 5 and 4.1.1 show most mature fields over 20 days in Jan–Mar 2026; Agro advises 15 days or less.

issues.title: Harvesting rounds 23 vs 22
issues.detail: PA 7.2 reports 23 of 24 rounds in 2025. Agro Table 11 averages 22 rounds (92%), with P93E at 10 and P95F at 22. The Group MD asked for the round records to be validated.

issues.title: Rat damage: none seen vs high census
issues.detail: PA 6.5.1 says no rat damage seen. Agro Table 9 shows census 20 to 21.5 in P18B and 10 to 11.5 in P13A3 in 2025 (units not stated) and Agro 4.5.1 calls infestation high; no 2026 census as of March.

issues.title: P93E2 replanting year conflicts
issues.detail: PA 2.2 says replanting was postponed to 2027. Agro Table 2 and 2.6 plan 34 ha in 2026 pending top-management approval, while Agro 4.1.3 says replanting is next year.

issues.title: Manuring completion differs
issues.detail: PA 6.4.1 says 2,417 ha or 100% applied. Agro Table 3 shows RP supplying 42% (2.25 of 5.40 t), CRF replanting 47% (1.78 of 3.82 t) and urea 5.00 t unapplied. Agro 3.2 says NK2 was completed in March 2026, but Table 4 shows 13.00 of 26.00 t (50%).

issues.title: Spraying hectares do not add up in PA
issues.detail: PA 6.2.1 states 1,487 ha (2.5 rounds) circle sprayed; the programmed rounds (2 rounds on 338 ha, 3 rounds on 239 ha) give 1,393 ha. PA 6.3.1 prints 582 ha out of 1,582 ha for selective spraying.

issues.title: PR25D area and cost lines
issues.detail: PA 12.2 heading says PR25D (94 ha) but the RM/ha figures use 60 ha (RM96,037 / 60 = RM1,601). Planting materials show RM nil actual vs RM135,270 budget while planting cost RM87,122 vs RM14,612; check where materials were booked.

issues.title: Typos and small mismatches in Agro
issues.detail: Agro 3.5 says six workers but lists four digging and three applying. Agro 4.5.4 names block P05F (not in the estate); photo captions cite P98. Agro heading gives PR24C as 42.57 ha vs 43 ha elsewhere. Planting-hole rates: Agro 6.3 says CRF 500 g and RP 600 g; Appendix 1b says CRF 600 g and RP 500 g.

actions.item: Reduce harvesting interval to 15 days or less; recruit missing harvesters (4 short Mar 2026)
Lift harvester productivity and working hours (5 to 6 hours vs 9); some earn below basic wage
Recruit 4 spraying workers (promised for June) and 1 manuring worker
Raise sprayer productivity (circle 3.7 ha/man-day, selective 4.2; target above 5)
Eradicate remaining VOPs (all fields, PR25D, P95F circles)
Ganoderma census and deboling of fallen palms (1.5 m pits) in blocks not due for replanting within 2 years
Update palm census (no progress despite advice)
Resume quarterly rat census in 2026 and bait P18B and P13A3
Clarify neglected barn owl project
Validate cumulative harvesting round records
Follow 2026 manuring schedule strictly; only 20% done by March, kieserite delivered but not applied
Find a more efficient subsurface manuring method; revise manuring rates against RM1,700 basic wage
Monitor and explain general charges overspend (RM1.61m vs RM0.99m) in 2026
Be precise on chemical issue vs usage (Garlon 0.45 l/ha, over-issued stock)
Expedite circle spraying in P01G; correct under-pruned palms
PR24C: at least two ablation rounds; improve Mucuna establishment; remove VOPs and Momordica
PR25D: supply and infill from 125 SPH to 136 to 148; apply EFB to all palms; finish cover crop
Decide P93E2 replanting year (2026 vs 2027) with top management; keep upkeep and harvesting meanwhile
Compaction with road grading in FY2026/27 and use more crusher run (on hold, diesel price)
Re-sample leaves in P01, P05, P13 and P18 in 2026
Stay vigilant for bagworm; manage cattle roaming in the estate

kb:
LADANG PERHENTIAN TINGGI, Enchant Hectares Sdn Bhd (Prosper group). Fact pack drawn from two reports. (1) PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisor Mr. Boey Chee Weng, advisory visit 14 May 2026, review period January to December 2025). (2) Agronomy Report 1/2026 (Junior Agronomist En. Muhammad Ghazali Abdul Ghani and Senior Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming, visit 13 April 2026, manuring programme 2026; previous agronomy visit 23 September 2025). Plantation Controller Dr. Chua Chin Kok; Senior Manager En. Zulkarnain Bin Barik; Manager Mr. Robin A/L Sinnappanah.

AREA (PA 1/2026, as at Dec 2025): estate title 736.00 ha. Mature 611.0 ha (83.02%), immature 43.0 ha (5.84%, PR24C), replanting 60.0 ha (8.15%, PR25D), total planted 714.0 ha (97.01%), labour quarters 22.0 ha (2.99%), no unplanted area. No change in area statement. Fields: P93E2 1993 Yangambi DxP 34 ha; P95F 1995 50 ha; P01G 2001 193 ha; P05H 2005 95 ha; P13A1 2013 43 ha; P13A2 2014 42 ha; P13A3 2013 60 ha; P18B 2018 94 ha; PR24C 2024 43 ha (Agro says 42.57 ha); PR25D 2025 60 ha. Agro Table 1 matches (P13A total 145 ha, total 714.00 ha). Agro: about 52% of planted area is ageing palms, of which 12% (84.00 ha, P93E2 plus P95F) is older than 26 years; immature plus replant is 14% (103.00 ha); P18B reaches prime age next year. Replanting programme (Agro Table 2): P93E2 34 ha in 2026 (4.76%), P95F 50 ha in 2027 (7.00%). PA 2.2 says P93E2 replanting was postponed to 2027 (Group MD had recommended 2026); Agro 2.6 says management is awaiting top-management confirmation. Pruning at P93E2 stopped in 2025 and manuring has ceased ahead of replanting; the block is weedy, under-pruned, palms very tall. P95F (replant 2027) is still well maintained. Agro: palm census data is outdated, no progress despite advice; accurate census needed for immature and young mature fertiliser recommendations.

LABOUR (PA, as at Dec 2025): total workers 43 versus 45 required (-2); checkroll 2, contract 41. Harvesters 31 versus 31 required (adequate, ratio 1:20 ha). Manuring workers 4 versus 5 (-1). Upkeep spraying workers 4 versus 4 in the table, but PA 3.2 and the comment column say spraying workers were short by 4 and 4 new workers would be recruited in June. Manuring mandore 1 versus 1. Internal transport drivers 2 versus 3 (-1). Security guard 1 versus 1. Worker to planted ha ratio 1:14 (satisfactory). Agro 4.1.4: estate records showed a shortage of four harvesters as of March 2026; no harvesters assigned to P93E2.

GENERAL CHARGES (PA, 2025): actual RM1,611,566.10 versus budget RM993,951.00 (62% over); RM2,257.10/ha versus RM1,392.09/ha. Management and supervision RM921,148.27 versus RM549,639 (RM1,290.12/ha versus 769.80); labour and amenities RM353,680.76 versus RM326,025; other expenditure RM297,118.96 versus RM105,387; MSPO RM39,618.11 versus RM12,900. PA 5.1: Pinfosys started March 2025; overspend attributed to under-budgeting of sub-codes in the old budget format. PA 5.2: Estate Manager to monitor 2026 overspending and give reasons.

UPKEEP AND CULTIVATION (PA, 2025, mature): total RM1,074,593 versus budget RM1,055,407 (+2%); RM1,758.74/ha versus RM1,727.34/ha. Per ha actual versus budget: weeding 199.33 vs 197.09; upkeep supervision 3.79 vs nil; manuring 1,323.14 vs 1,189.68; pest and disease 17.01 vs 114.12; census and thinning 7.46 vs nil; drains 4.16 vs nil; roads 33.09 vs 81.05; culverts and bridges 47.48 vs 21.10; tools 0.45; supplying nil vs 4.79; pruning 122.84 vs 119.52.

WEEDING (PA 1/2026 and Agro 1/2026): PA circle spraying reported 1,487 ha (2.5 rounds) or 100% of budget in 2025; 2 rounds budgeted for old plantings and 3 for young mature. Inter Pump output 3.7 ha/man-day (target 4.5; GMD wants over 5), piece rate RM20/ha (group usually RM16 to 17), earnings RM74/man-day, glyphosate 0.37 l/ha (1.9 pumps/ha), 6 pumps/man-day versus 12 target. Only glyphosate is used for circles (GMD had queried Ally). Selective spraying 582 ha (2.6 rounds), 100% (PA text prints out of 1582 ha); mist blower 4.2 ha/man-day, RM20/ha, RM84/man-day, Garlon 0.45 l/ha (3 pumps/ha, considered high; chemicals over-issued and charged out to the contractor, which distorts usage). Circles clean except P01G where circles were due. Inter-rows well maintained, sporadic soft woodies, remaining VOPs to be eradicated. Agro Tables 7 and 8: all 2025 inter-row and circle rounds 100% in all fields; 2026 to March inter-row first round 100% in all fields, circle first round done in P13A1 and P95F only. Agro: significant VOPs inside circles in P95F; P93E2 heavily overgrown, blanket spraying planned.

MANURING 2025 (PA and Agro Table 3): PA says 2,417 ha or 100% of budget applied; wheelbarrow output 27 bags/man-day, RM2.50/bag, RM67.50/day (PA suggests revising rates against the new RM1,700/month basic wage); subsurface in P01G done May 2025 at 15 bags/man-day, 0.8 ha/man-day, RM3.50/bag, RM52.50/day (below basic wage RM65.38). Tonnage 2025 all 100%: Compound B 286.30 t; Mixture A 284.75 t; kieserite 21.25 t; RP 74.60 t; NK2 26.00 t; RP replanting 10.20 t; Comp 25 replanting 24.55 t. Not complete (Agro Table 3): RP supplying 2.25 of 5.40 t (42%); CRF replanting 1.78 of 3.82 t (47%); urea 5.00 t not applied. Agro 3.1: subsurface Mixture A in P01G finished four months behind schedule.
MANURING 2026 (Agro Table 4, to March 2026): total applied 158.59 t of 767.28 t required (20%). Compound B 73.20 of 286.50 t (26%); Mixture A 61.85 of 288.80 t (21%, 87.60 t delivered); NK2 13.00 of 26.00 t (50%); kieserite 24.40 t delivered, 0% applied; RP 0 of 74.45 t; Comp 25 immature 5.85 of 39.60 t (15%); RP immature 0 of 22.45 t; RP supplying 2.65 t used; CRF replanting 2.04 t used; RP replanting 0 of 2.30 t. Agro 3.2 says first Mix B round done in P13A and P18B and NK2 completed in March, but Table 4 shows NK2 at 50%.

PEST AND DISEASE (PA and Agro): PA: no rat damage seen; 2 rounds of cypermethrin at P13A1, P13A3 and P18B for bagworm, no new infestation but old attacks seen in P13A3 and P18B; many cattle roaming in the estate; Ganoderma widespread (fruiting bodies in P05H and P01G) so census and deboling advised at blocks not to be replanted in the next 2 years. Agro Table 9 rat census 2025: P18B 20 to 21.5, P13A3 10 to 11.5 (units not stated). Agro says high rat infestation in P18B and P13A3; no 2026 rat census done as of March 2026. Bagworm Metisa plana seen in P13 and P05, low (empty pupae, inactive larvae). Ganoderma symptoms: census and deboling advised, pit 1.5 m x 1.5 m x 1.5 m. Barn owl project neglected (GMD query).

PRUNING (PA 6.6 and Agro Table 6): 6,924 of 6,924 ha (12 rounds x 577 ha) progressive pruning done, 100%; some under-pruned palms seen (PA). Agro: all fields 100% in 2025 except P93E2; three rounds done by March 2026 in P95F, P01G, P05H, P13; quality satisfactory, low over-pruning.

ROADS, DRAINS, VEHICLES, CAPEX (PA): 2,000 chains grading budgeted at RM9.50/chain, none done (no compaction; compaction with grading planned FY2026/27 but on hold due to diesel price); hilly sections damaged. Crusher run 25.0 of 250 MT bought at RM22/MT. No drain budget, no drain issues. Capex budget RM80,000, nothing spent.

HARVESTING AND COLLECTION (PA, 2025): total RM868,498.08 = RM75.59/t versus budget RM912,349 = RM73.16/t. Labour RM551,526 (RM48.00/t vs 47.66); internal transport RM200,919.08 (17.49 vs 17.49); incentive RM93,798 (8.16 vs 8.00); top-up wages RM22,255 (1.94 vs nil) for new harvesters. Rounds 23 of 24 budget (PA). Current interval averaged 16 days (PA). Outturn 93%. 4 mini dumpers (2 cutters and 1 collector each), wheelbarrows elsewhere. Rates and output (RM/t, t/man-day, average earning): P93E 59, 1.15, RM67.85; P95F 48, 1.40, RM67.20; P01G 41, 1.90, RM77.90; P05H 35, 1.83, RM64.05; P13A 34, 2.38, RM80.92; P18B 53, 1.93, RM102.29; basic wage RM65.39. Harvesters work 5 to 6 hours a day and should aim for 9.
Agro Table 5 harvesting intervals Jan to Apr 2026: mostly 18 to 23 days in Jan to Mar, exceeding 20 days in most mature areas (blamed on persistent rain and labour). Overripe bunches seen at P05H and P13A2 platforms; advice to reduce the interval to 15 days or less. Agro Table 11 cumulative rounds 2025: P93E 10 (42%), P95F 22 (96%), P01G, P05H, P13A1, A2, A3 and P18B 24 (100%); average 22 (92%). Agro Table 13 rounds to March 2026: P93E 2 (33%), all others 6 (100%), average 5.5 (92%).

CROP 2025 (PA section 8): FFB 11,489.06 t versus budget 12,471 t (2024: 11,869.80 t). Yield 18.80 t/ha versus budget 20.41 (8% below) and 17.69 in 2024 (PA says 6% higher). CPO 2,182.92 t versus 2,370 t (2024: 2,255.26 t); CPO yield 3.57 t/ha vs 3.88; kernel 459.56 t vs 500; OER 19.00% (budget 19.00%); kernel 4.00%. Shortfall mainly harvester shortage early in 2025. At visit the estate was in a low cropping season except P18B (good fruit sets). Bunch weight Dec 2024 to Dec 2025 (PA): 1995 24.9 to 24.9 kg; 2001 24.7 to 25.0; 2005 24.4 to 24.9; 2013 A1 14.9 to 16.2; A2 14.6 to 15.1; A3 15.1 to 15.0; 2018 6.6 to 8.8 kg.
Agro Table 10 and Appendix 2 yields 2025 (t/ha, FFB t): P93E 7.30 on 34 ha (248.26 t; 2024 13.85); P95F 16.01 (800.47 t; 2024 16.50); P01G 17.48 (3,374.29 t; 17.14); P05H 21.15 (2,009.09 t; 19.17); P13A1 22.82 (981.37 t; 21.50); P13A2 20.31 (853.22 t; 19.23); P13A3 22.13 (1,327.72 t; 22.34); P18B 20.16 (1,894.64 t; 16.40); estate 18.80 (11,489.06 t). Agro says 2025 was 4% above 2024, quoting 2024 as 18.07 t/ha; Agro Appendix 2 and 3 show 2024 as 11,871.80 t or 11,869.80 t on 671 ha, which is 17.69 t/ha. Agro: P93E yield exceptionally low due to incomplete crop recovery and replanting of P93E1.
Yield by year (Agro Appendix 3, t/ha on stated area): 2021 16.33 (10,118.03 t, 619.62 ha); 2022 16.36 (10,134.76 t); 2023 15.67 (11,188.91 t, 714.20 ha); 2024 17.69 (11,869.80 t, 671 ha); 2025 18.80 (11,489.06 t, 611 ha).
YIELD JAN TO MAR 2026 (Agro Table 12 and Appendix 2, 611 ha): estate 4.06 t/ha (2,482.19 t) versus 4.13 t/ha in Jan to Mar 2025 (-2%). By block 2026 vs 2025: P93E 0.41 vs 5.18 (-92%); P95F 2.79 vs 3.30 (-15%); P01G 3.87 vs 3.74 (+3%); P05H 4.65 vs 4.60 (+1%); P13A1 5.47 vs 5.03 (+9%); P13A2 4.84 vs 4.58 (+6%); P13A3 5.28 vs 5.56 (-5%); P18B 4.09 vs 2.98 (+37%). Monthly FFB 2026: Jan 990.51 t; Feb 773.51 t; Mar 718.17 t. Agro 7.4: decline mainly incomplete crop recovery in old plantings (P93E, P95F).

PRODUCTION COST (PA section 9, 2025): RM309.39/t FFB versus budget RM237.49/t (total RM3,554,657.18 vs RM2,961,707). General charges RM140.27/t vs 79.70; upkeep RM93.53/t vs 84.63; harvesting RM75.59/t vs 73.16. PA: cost high because the crop budget was not achieved (and general charges overspent).

IMMATURE PR24C, 43 ha (PA 12.1 and Agro 5): upkeep RM99,425 versus budget RM128,797 in 2025 (RM2,312/ha vs 2,995). Circle spraying 258 ha (6 rounds) 100%; selective 204 ha (5 rounds), 79%. Manuring 215 ha 100%. Cypermethrin 12 rounds, Oryctes attack minimal. No supplying needed. Agro: acceptable vigour, about 15 months old; first Compound 25 round on schedule; advise at least two ablation rounds; Mucuna bracteata establishment below expectation; soft grasses dominant; scattered VOPs and Momordica charantia to remove; no Oryctes.
REPLANTING PR25D, 60 ha (ex-P93E1) (PA 12.2 and Agro 6): upkeep RM96,037 vs budget RM38,859 (RM1,601/ha vs 648); felling and clearing RM66,105; terracing RM76,946; lining and holing RM14,652; planting RM87,122 vs RM14,612 budget; planting materials RM nil actual vs RM135,270 budget; cover crops RM26,628; total felling and clearing RM280,438 vs RM357,580. Two blanket spray rounds (Jun and Sep 2025), many remaining VOPs to eradicate. Palm planting completed Feb 2026 (first stage palms 10 months old, second stage 12 months old, from Cheekah Kemayan nursery). Vacant points; Agro: density only 125 SPH versus recommended 136 to 148, needs supplying and infilling. Planting hole CRF 500 g plus RP 600 g (Agro text; Appendix 1b says CRF 600 g and RP 500 g). PA recommends EFB on all planted palms (lateritic soil).

2026 FERTILISER PROGRAMME (Agro Appendix 1, revised, g per palm; month placement approximate from the PDF layout): P95F none (replant 2027). P01G Mix A 7,000 g subsurface in 4 holes (Jan). P05H Mix A 2,000 g three times (Feb, May, Sep). P13A1, A2, A3 Mix B 2,250 g (Jan), kieserite 750 g (Mar), Mix B 2,250 g (Apr), RP 1,500 g, Mix B 2,250 g. P18B Mix B 2,250 g (Feb), kieserite 750 g (Mar), Mix B 2,000 g, RP 2,000 g, Mix B 1,500 g, Mix B 1,500 g (Nov). PR24C compound 25 at 1,000 g, 1,000 g, 1,200 g, 1,200 g with RP 1,750 g. PR25D CRF 600 g and RP 500 g at transplanting, then compound 800 g, RP 1,500 g and compound 900 g. Mix A is 45% AS, 40% MOP, 15% kieserite; Mix B is 45% AS, 40% MOP, 14% kieserite, 1% borate; NK2 is 60% AS, 40% MOP; compound 25 is 14:13:9:2.5; CRF 20:6:14:3. The 2027 programme will be drawn up after a field inspection in the second half of 2026. Agro 4.2.2: only mild potassium deficiency and slight magnesium deficiency in localised P13A (marginal soil); no serious deficiencies.

RAINFALL (PA Appendix 1 and Agro Appendix 4): 2021 2,440.40 mm, 100 days; 2022 3,013.05 mm, 124 days; 2023 2,575.30 mm, 100 days; 2024 2,924.30 mm, 152 days; 2025 2,481.00 mm, 145 days. 2026 Jan to Mar 362.50 mm, 17 days (Jan 48.5 mm; Feb 198.0 mm; Mar 116.0 mm).

DATA CAVEATS: Agro Table 10 quotes 2024 as 18.07 t/ha (4% growth) while PA and Agro appendices give 17.69 t/ha (6% growth). Agro Table 10 shows P93E on 94 ha with 7.30 t/ha for 2025, which only works on 34 ha (Appendix 2 gives 2.64 t/ha on 94 ha). Agro 7.1 says P13A1 had the highest yield at 21.15 t/ha but P05H is 21.15 and P13A1 is 22.82. PA labour table shows no spraying shortage while text says short 4. PA says harvesters adequate (31 vs 31) but the crop shortfall is blamed on harvester shortage; Agro says short 4 in March 2026. Harvest interval 16 days (PA) versus mostly over 20 days (Agro). Rounds 23 (PA) versus average 22 (Agro). PA says no rat damage; Agro census shows about 21% in P18B. Replanting of P93E2 is 2027 in PA but 2026 in Agro Table 2.
